text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Brussels approved a line of credit for 150 billion escudos to assist the recovery of the Portuguese agricultural sector.
- Banco Mello de Investimentos bought 49 percent of editorial group Bertrand.
- Health Minister Maria de Belem attempts to save costs of medicines in state hospitals.
- Portugal Telecom and Telecel shares hit a high on Lisbon bourse yesterday amid euphoria over the telecommunications sector.
- Banco Cisf, a unit of Banco Comercial Portugues, posted a 1996 profit of 1.6 billion escudos, up from 1.52 billion in 1995.
- Nine years after privatisations began in Portugal, the state still controls more than 600 companies.
